about_the_game:
The Monster Con is back in town! Put on your favorite cosplay and grab your autograph book, because you’re going back to the craziest convention ever… with 2 brand new playable characters to choose from!

  • Aaravi is back on a quest... a quest for love! Become the Slayer as she fills the role she was always fated for: a playable character. She's always had main character energy, and it was about time we acknowledged that. So pack all your equipment and potions, because the con can be tougher than your regular dungeon!

  • But so much high energy needs a more chill counterpart, and nothing feels more relaxing than Milo's whole bon vivant approach to life. Everyone loves the dreamy reaper/influencer... and now you can become them, as they put aside their constant pursuit of likes... so they can begin a pursuit for love.

Get ready to nerd out with hot monsters... and be a hot, nerdy monster yourself!

content_descriptors.notes: Use of mature language in a humorous way.
